parsed.answer: The claim is supported: feeding rapamycin to adult Drosophila melanogaster produced the life span extension seen in some TOR mutants, with the increase associated with greater resistance to starvation and paraquat. The effect was shown to act specifically through the TORC1 branch of the TOR pathway via alterations in autophagy and translation. Lifespan extension also occurred in weak insulin/Igf signaling mutants and in flies already long-lived under dietary restriction, indicating additional mechanisms.
